result:
I implemented `Date.prototype.toLocaleTimeString` in place of the not-implemented stub. It returns the local time as `HH:MM:SS`, or `"Invalid Date"` for a NaN time value. It ignores the reserved parameters. `cargo clippy` is clean, and `./t262 built-ins/Date/prototype/toLocaleTimeString/` passes 8/8.

Those 8 already passed before my change, so this adds no new test262 passes. The earlier attempts were rejected for the same reason.

I didn't add the spec's step-by-step comments for the time-value check, because this spec text has no numbered steps.
